data.user_prompt: What are the top data lake consulting companies?

sections.text:
Top data lake consulting companies in 2026 include:

| Company | Best suited for | Notable strengths |
|---|---|---|
| **Accenture** | Global enterprises and complex transformations | Large-scale cloud migration, multi-cloud data platforms, and enterprise analytics[7][9] |
| **Deloitte** | Governance, compliance, and regulated industries | Data strategy, secure architectures, governance, and modernization[6][7] |
| **Capgemini** | Large, complex IT environments | Cloud-native data platforms, integration, and enterprise-scale delivery[1][7] |
| **Slalom** | Flexible, business-focused implementations | AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud delivery with relatively fast deployment cycles[1][6] |
| **Cognizant** | Legacy-system modernization | Integrating existing systems with modern data lakes and real-time analytics[6][9] |
| **Thoughtworks** | Product-oriented and adaptable data platforms | Modern architecture, engineering practices, and data governance[8][10] |
| **IBM Consulting** | Hybrid-cloud and AI-heavy environments | Hybrid-cloud data management, analytics, and AI integration[7][9] |
| **Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** | Global, large-volume implementations | Scalable data-lake architecture and AI/analytics integration[7][9] |
| **Infosys** | Enterprise cloud modernization | Data engineering, cloud transformation, analytics, and machine learning[7][9] |
| **Wipro** | Secure multi-cloud programs | Cloud data platforms, modernization, and scalable analytics infrastructure[7][9] |
| **N-iX** | Mid-market and enterprise lakehouse projects | Snowflake and AWS expertise, data engineering, and industry-focused delivery[2][3] |
| **STX Next** | Data lakehouse implementations | Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Iceberg, and proof-of-concept-to-production work[2][3] |
| **Adastra** | Regulated and data-intensive industries | Databricks, AWS, cloud migration, and proprietary migration tooling[2][3] |
| **Quantiphi** | AI/ML-first data platforms | Google Cloud and AWS implementations focused on predictive analytics[6] |
| **Tredence** | Retail, consumer, and telecom analytics | Databricks, Snowflake, feature engineering, and data science[6] |

**Best overall shortlist:** Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, Slalom, and Cognizant for large enterprise programs; STX Next, N-iX, and Adastra for more specialized lakehouse implementations; Quantiphi and Tredence for AI- and analytics-heavy use cases.[1][2][6]

When evaluating firms, compare their experience with your target platform—such as **Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Fabric**—along with migration methodology, governance capabilities, industry references, and ongoing managed-services support.
